resources.string: Restores missing Sound, Vibrate, and Silent toggles to Google Pixel
Required by Android to mute phone calls and notification sounds. This does not activate Do Not Disturb.
Required to toggle Pixel\'s master \"Use vibration & haptics\" switch and call vibration.
1. Swipe down twice from the top of your Pixel screen.
2. Tap the Pencil (Edit) icon at the bottom-right corner.
3. Scroll down through available tiles to find \"Ringer\" and \"Vibration\".
4. Hold and drag them into the top active 4–8 quick tile pills.
Pixel Power Users: Master Switch via ADB
To grant write access to secure system tables across reboots:\nadb shell pm grant com.example.quicktiles android.permission.WRITE_SECURE_SETTINGS
